interpretation_boundary: Depth is insufficient for exact future-route prediction: same progress count can identify states with different continuation signatures. Pair-scoped removal-set and addition-set projections are injective and sufficient over this measured reachable family; full path history is not required. These are finite current-contract state results, not semantic causality claims.

continuation_state_complexity.interpretation: 13 bits is the information-theoretic lower bound for indexing 4104 distinct signatures, not the size of a literal declaration representation.
